text:
jen: Quick flag — after the midnight route-resolver roll in EU I'm seeing a small but consistent mismatch between invoice preview and final for a narrow tenant cohort. Preview shows extra tokens in `unknown-route`.

david: timeline? which change landed?

jen: resolver v2 landed 00:12 UTC. It moved resolution to a different enrichment stage. Preview still reads the pre-enriched stream for a short window, so tokens show up as `unknown-route` until finalizer enriches.

maya: any customers billed incorrectly?

jen: no, final invoices are correct. The harm is support noise — CS saw preview and opened tickets.

metering-bot: scanning recent windows: 37 preview events with null route_resolution between 8712345600..8712345700 in eu cluster.

alan: sounds like a topology race. Short-term: flip preview consumer to read enriched topic as a canary for the region. Low-risk config change.

david: UX mitigation: add a small banner on invoice-preview: "Preview may be transient during routing rollouts; final invoices are authoritative." Also add a `preview_confidence` flag to the preview payload.

jen: starting canary on partition 2 now.

sre-bot: deploy started: preview-consumer->read-enriched.canary (eu, partition-2).

jen: results: preview delta dropped from ~2.6% -> 0.2% in ~5m after canary.

david: great. I'll ship the banner behind a feature flag and add the preview_confidence boolean.

maya: I'll prepare a short CS blurb + reconciliation query snippet for support: `SELECT session_id, SUM(tokens) FROM preview WHERE ts > t0 GROUP BY session_id` then join with final tokens.

alan: long term we should either move enrichment upstream so both preview and final read the same enriched stream or replicate finalizer logic in preview. Also consider tagging events with `post_enrichment` boolean so UI can show lower confidence for in-flight events.

jen: ticket created: MP-9001 "preview/final attribution delta post-route-resolver-v2" assigned to jen/alan/david/maya. No billing impact.

metering-bot: created alert: preview_vs_final_delta.eu > 1% at 8712345690.

jen: canary stable at 30m and promoted region-wide. Leaving banner until design decision. Closing unless anyone objects.

david: sounds good. add postmortem note in the rollout doc.

maya: will send CS replies and update runbook.

alan: adding follow-up to ticket to evaluate enrichment placement next sprint.

jen: thanks all. :thumbsup:
